skills.name: Snow Chaser (雪走)
skills.line: No one has crossed this blade and lived...
skills.description: Yuki Douji draws Snow Chaser from its sheath and slashes a single target, dealing damage equal to 80% of his ATK.

skills.name: Snow Weaver (霜天之织/霜降る衣)
skills.description:
When Yuki Douji attacks or deals transferred damage, he has a 25% base chance of inflicting the enemy with Freeze, lasts for 1 turn. Attacking Freeze targets again converts it into Deep Freeze and inflicts Ice Mark on the enemy for 2 turns. He also breaks the ice around enemies with Freeze, Deep Freeze or Frostbound, increasing his damage dealt to them by 300%. When inflicting a freeze type effect on an enemy, gains an undispellable shield that absorbs damage equal to 150% of Yuki's starting ATK for 2 turns. Gains Frostwoven Shelter at the start of the battle and at the end of each turn.
;

;Frostwoven Shelter (霜衣の守り)
:'''General, Mark''': Negates the effect of Suppress, Seal, Freeze, Deep Freeze, Frostbound or Banish once. If the target has Shelter, loses Frostwoven Shelter and removes the target's Shelter.
:''(A blue snowflake will appear underneath him while Frostwoven Shelter is active.)''
;Freezing Effect
:Freeze, Deep Freeze, Frostbound, and Rest in Ice
